0022600127.text: The Nuggets (1-1, 4th in the Northwest and 8th in the West) host the Warriors (0-3, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West), who have lost three straight. Denver is missing Julian Strawther, who is out with a knee sprain, and is listed as day-to-day with Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). Golden State is without Jimmy Butler (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are listed as day-to-day. The teams have not met yet this season, but they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Denver won their most recent meeting 116-93 in Denver.
